sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Thank you for your offer. We have moved on our side; please see our updated terms.

To support the price in our term sheet:
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
We placed our last 3 orders for this part at EUR 5.84 per unit (po:4500014427-10, po:4500014355-10, po:4500014292-10).
Your on-time delivery averaged 82.5% over the last 4 quarters (sc:70740@2026Q3, sc:70740@2026Q2, sc:70740@2026Q1, sc:70740@2025Q4).
Which of the packages in our term sheet works best for you?

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We also checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We are prepared to accept the 24-month contract and the AS-14404 index clause outlined in your second option. In exchange for a price of EUR 5.80 per unit, we require a 60-day payment term rather than 90 days. 

Currently, our main Angebot stands at a price of €5.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net: €5.80 per unit, with a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Our standard terms apply to everything the quote does not state; see attached. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Dear customer,

We appreciate your revised offer and your continued movement. As a broad-range distributor, we always strive to support your requirements with excellent service and high-quality materials. In response, we can reduce our price to EUR 5.60 per unit for the package with a 90-day payment term and a 24-month contract. 

To present our complete Angebot, our offer stands at a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

This is a significant concession on our part and reflects our commitment to finding a mutually beneficial agreement. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Our standard terms apply to everything the quote does not state; see attached. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
